rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being extremely interested or absorbed in something.

example.english: I was fascinated by this documentary.
example.traditional: 我睇呢套紀錄片睇到入迷。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tai2 nei1 tou3 gei2 luk6 pin2 tai2 dou3 jap6 mai4

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that a particular person, thing, or experience has captivated the speaker.

example.english: I was fascinated by that novel and did not want to sleep all night.
example.traditional: 我畀嗰本小說吸引住，成晚都唔捨得瞓。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bei2 go2 bun2 siu2 syut3 kap1 jan5 zyu6 seng4 maan5 dou1 m4 se2 dak1 fan3
